hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: PmavHookQuoted (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) is a bonding curve hook for token launches on Robinhood Chain quoted in an ERC20 (USDG/stock tokens). It enforces block+1 anti-snipe, a permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund waterfall, a decaying anti-snipe fee premium, and auto-graduates pools to a locked full-range LP position once the raise target is met.
